# Sprint 2-A data fixtures (DO NOT EDIT)

Generated by the Sprint 2-A code (main `49be933`, ImageSpec `0.2.0`, catalog `prompter.core@0.3.0`,
compiler `0.3.0`, safety `prompter.baseline@0.1.0`) before any Sprint 2-B.1 change, by running
`capture-script.txt` (a vitest file) against an extracted copy of that commit. Used to prove lossless
0.2.0 → 0.3.0 migration and prompt regression in later versions.

- `export-core-detailed.json` — every approved Detailed attribute of the core catalog (Basic + 6 lighting
  properties); the lighting preset's “warm” unit is taken over by a direct color temperature
- `export-fixture-preset.json` — E2E fixture catalog spec written by the real preset flow (`p_soft_portrait`),
  i.e. selections with `source: "preset"` and persistent `origin`
- `localstorage-workspace.txt` — raw `prompter:v1:workspace` value of `export-core-detailed`
- `expected-prompts.json` — the exact prompts, fragments and parameters Sprint 2-A produced
